object.attr: derived: CF-S27, CF-S28, E3, F14. Without a flush, a file replaced just before a power loss can come back empty or zero-filled and lose its uncommitted edits, which nothing else keeps. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S2): flush before replacing, measured on the reference machine.
object.description: If power fails during or after Mellon's write of a file, Mellon shall leave the file holding either its content before the write or the full content written.
